title: Juicy Argentinian Haddock Gratin
description: A winey, cheese-pull, lazy-sunday argentinian dish featuring haddock, cooked in a bain-marie for a pescatarian-friendly meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large saucepan, combine the white wine, butter, lemon juice, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper, and bring to a simmer over medium heat.
Reduce the heat to low and place a heatproof dish containing the haddock fillets into the saucepan, making sure the fish is covered with the wine mixture.
Cover the saucepan with a lid and cook for 8 minutes, or until the fish is cooked through.
While the fish is cooking, mix the grated cheddar cheese and chopped parsley in a small bowl.
Remove the fish from the wine mixture and place it in a baking dish.
Spoon the cheese and parsley mixture evenly over the top of the haddock fillets.
Place the baking dish under the broiler and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove the dish from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
